name: Rutabaga

schedule.notes: Time backwards from first frost. Hot summer growth = woody roots.
After hard frost. Roots can stay in the ground under mulch through winter.

harvest.cues: Roots 4 to 5 in across at the shoulder, purple-top and yellow flesh.
harvest.storageNotes: Top, fridge 1 month. Damp sand in a cellar: 4 to 6 months. Waxed for grocery sale: lasts even longer.

varieties.name: Joan
varieties.notes: Smoother shoulders, less side roots. Easier to peel.

notes: Fall crop only — spring planting bolts in heat. Two hard frosts before harvest convert starch to sugar; the difference is dramatic.
